nodes.relation: H092 replaces ordinary rational Gram factors by exact rational LDL certificates, which cover singular rational PSD matrices without adjoining square roots.
H093 combines exact LDL positivity with one fixed primal-dual Lovasz-theta formulation and exact objective equality.
H094 extracts the one-sided consequence needed for SAT: a verified rational dual upper bound below the clause target certifies UNSAT without computing the exact optimum.
H095 adds the disjoint-union amplification step required to turn one certified finite collision seed into an explicit infinite family.
H096 replaces the broad twin conjecture by one finite bundle with exact alpha diagnostics, exact primal-dual theta certificates, equal targets, and opposite SAT labels.
H097 isolates the remaining certificate-existence question under explicit Slater and objective margins after exact verification has been solved.
